clips.attack_primary: Crushing bite: rocks back with the jaws gaping, darts forward and down to a survivor's height, clamps shut (hit 0.42) and wrenches back. A landed bite turns into the grab (pin_stab)
clips.pin_stab: Grab and shake: the jaws stay clamped on the prey held low in front, two violent side-to-side shakes (hits 0.38 and 0.74), then it lets go
clips.attack_heavy: Skull-knob headbutt: rears back with the chin tucked so the knob faces the prey, paws the ground with a hind foot (telegraph), then a stepping drive knob first (hit 0.72)
clips.kick: Low tail swipe: the hips pivot and the stiff tail sweeps round low at a prey behind it (hit 0.45)
clips.charge: The run with the body level and the jaws pushed out ahead: the rush at wounded prey that ends in the crushing bite
clips.alert: Roar: head rears up, then thrusts forward with the jaws wide and shaking, a stamp of the right foot
clips.knockdown: Knees buckle, topples onto its right side and lies there
